entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: A hybrid demonic dragon from Grixis, spawn of a demon and a dragon.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Malfegor was exiled.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: Shard where Malfegor was thought dead and later assaulted.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: Planeswalker who was imprisoned on Grixis and escaped.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who made Malfegor his second-in-command.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: Event after which Bolas contacted Malfegor.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: Coming event after which Bolas planned an invasion.

events.summary: Malfegor slays the archangel Asha and is exiled to Grixis.
On Grixis Malfegor kidnaps and tortures fledgling planeswalkers; his first success is Sifa Grent.
events.quote: His first success was Sifa Grent .

events.summary: Dack Fayden is imprisoned, escapes, and kills Malfegor's head jailer.
events.quote: After Dack killed Malfegor's head jailer, Malfegor tried to take matters into his own hands but Dack escaped.

events.summary: Bolas persuades Malfegor to serve as his second-in-command on Alara.
events.quote: persuaded him to serve as the planeswalker's second-in-command on Alara

events.summary: Malfegor leads troops across Esper wiping out nearly every sphinx except Sharuum, then assaults Bant.
events.quote: wiping out nearly every sphinx except Sharuum

events.summary: Malfegor is killed during the siege of Bant by Rafiq and Elspeth Tirel.
events.quote: Malfegor was killed by the combined forces of Rafiq and Elspeth Tirel .
